release_notes:
feat(demo): homepage quick-login bar + prefilled demo credentials

When IS_DEMO is true, show a floating 'Login as Admin' / 'Login as Customer'
bar on public pages and prefill the admin and client login forms with the demo
credentials. Also re-enable the admin login button in demo mode (it was
hard-disabled) so demo visitors can actually sign in. All gated by IS_DEMO, so
real installs are unaffected.

(cherry picked from commit 0c1f5d97194b848a6c33b20376c0eda01fad229b)
